name: Smart Video Scheduler
description: An early content-calendar page with Calendar, Schedule and Analytics tabs. The Schedule tab opens the Publish to Social window to publish now; timed scheduling is not available yet.
shortDescription: Content calendar page with Calendar, Schedule and Analytics tabs (preview). The Schedule tab opens Publish to Social.
fullDescription: Smart Video Scheduler (#/smart-video-scheduler, also opened by #/brightbean) is a preview of a content calendar. The page title reads 'Smart Video Scheduler'. Three tabs switch the main area: Calendar shows 'Content Calendar - Your scheduled posts will appear here. Connect your social accounts to start scheduling.', Schedule shows 'Publish a video - Pick a video, add a caption and an AI-generated thumbnail, then publish it to your connected accounts. Timed scheduling is not available yet.' with a 'Publish to Social' button that opens the Publish to Social window (steps: Media, Thumbnail, Copy, Platform, Preview) and Analytics shows 'Analytics - Track your post performance across all platforms.' Calendar and Analytics are placeholder messages with no calendar grid or data. You can publish a video right away from the Schedule tab, including creating a thumbnail with AI, but you cannot choose a future date or time: timed scheduling is not built, and muapi's social API publishes immediately.
bestFor: People who want to publish a video to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram from the scheduler page, and to see what the planned calendar and analytics areas will look like. Scheduling a post for later is not available yet.
whenToUse: You want to look at the planned content calendar, scheduling and analytics areas.
You were sent a link to #/smart-video-scheduler or #/brightbean and want to know what it is.
whenToUseAnother: Use Video Studio (#/video) or Image Studio (#/image) to make the content you want to post; their results have publishing options.
Use Smart Video Viral (#/viral) for short-form social video ideas and clips.
Use Library (#/library) to find content you already made.
keyFeatures: Schedule tab: 'Publish to Social' button that opens the Publish to Social window (publishes now)

featureExplanations.explanation: The tab that is open when the page loads. It shows 'Content Calendar' and the message 'Your scheduled posts will appear here. Connect your social accounts to start scheduling.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see where scheduled posts are meant to appear.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no calendar grid or posts are shown, and there is no button on this page to connect social accounts.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Schedule' to see 'Publish a video' and a 'Publish to Social' button. The button opens the Publish to Social window, where you choose the media, create or pick a thumbnail (including an AI-generated one), write the copy, pick a connected account and publish.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To publish a video with a thumbnail without leaving the scheduler.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: A public link to the video, a connected account and your muapi API key.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Publishes immediately: there is no date or time picker, and no posting times are suggested.

featureExplanations.explanation: Click 'Analytics' to see 'Analytics' and the message 'Track your post performance across all platforms.'
featureExplanations.whyToUse: To see the planned performance area.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Placeholder only: no numbers or charts are shown.

howToUse: 1. Open #/smart-video-scheduler (or #/brightbean). 2. Click Schedule. 3. Click Publish to Social and follow the steps: Media, Thumbnail, Copy, Platform, Preview. 4. The Calendar and Analytics tabs show a short message only.
howToSteps: Click Schedule, then Publish to Social.
Add the media, a thumbnail and the copy, choose an account and publish.
gettingStarted: Use the Schedule tab's Publish to Social button to publish now; nothing can be scheduled for later yet.
Connect your social accounts and add your muapi API key when the window asks.
modelCapabilities: None. The page does not call any AI model.
limitations: Calendar and Analytics are placeholder messages with no data.
No timed scheduling: posts are published immediately, there is no date or time picker.
The selected tab is not remembered; the page always opens on Calendar.

limitationDetails.impact: You cannot choose a future date or time for a post; Publish to Social posts right away.
limitationDetails.workaround: Publish when you want the post to go live.

troubleshooting: I see no posts in the Calendar: the calendar is not built yet; it always shows the 'Content Calendar' message.
I cannot find a caption helper: this page has none. Write captions in the studio you publish from.

commonProblems.problem: Cannot find a way to schedule a post
commonProblems.whyItHappens: Timed scheduling is not built yet; the Schedule tab publishes immediately.
commonProblems.howToFix: Use Publish to Social when you want the post live.

Create a thumbnail, write the copy, choose an account and publish

faqs.question: Can I schedule social posts here?
faqs.answer: Not for a future time yet. The Schedule tab has a 'Publish to Social' button that posts right away; there are no date or time controls.

faqs.question: How do I connect my social accounts?
faqs.answer: Inside the Publish to Social window, on the Platform step, use the Connect YouTube, Connect TikTok or Connect Instagram buttons. The scheduler page itself has no connect button.

faqs.question: Can the scheduler write captions with AI?
faqs.answer: The Publish to Social window has a Copy step with an Enhance button for the title, description and caption, and a Thumbnail step that creates an AI thumbnail. The scheduler page itself has no caption helper.

faqs.question: What is #/brightbean?
faqs.answer: Another address for the same Smart Video Scheduler page.

glossary.Content calendar: A plan of which posts go out on which days.
glossary.Scheduling: Choosing a future date and time for a post to be published.

bestPractices: Check the Platform step shows your connected account before you publish.
